But we might want to limit each search to 5? The user wants top 5 relevant cases overall. We can search each location separately with limit 5, then combine results. But if each returns 5, we might have up to 10. But user says "display briefs of top 5 relevant cases." So maybe we should search across both locations together? But the search function only accepts one location. Could we search with location "New York" and query "Theft" and year 2021, limit 5. Then same for San Francisco. Then combine lists and pick top 5? But we don't know relevance ranking. We could just combine and take first 5. Let's do that.

We'll call search for New York: location="New York", query="Theft", year=2021, limit=5. Then for San Francisco: location="San Francisco", query="Theft", year=2021, limit=5. Then combine case IDs. Then call briefs_display_cases with combined list. That will return briefs. We'll output the briefs.
